_comment: Pages the tarkov.dev task set points at a title that is not a wiki page, so neither the
wikiLink nor the normalized name can bridge them. Without an entry here the page has no
game record, the liveness rule holds it back, and the quest leaves the app.
Every entry names the upstream report it waits on: this list is a workaround, not a
second source of truth. The refresh report flags an entry whose page matches without it,
which is how an entry gets retired once upstream fixes the link.
